in_marathi.name: Goyal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Goyal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'gopala', meaning 'cowherd' or 'protector'. In Hindu mythology, Goyal is a name associated with the god Krishna, who is often depicted as a cowherd and protector of his people.
